body:
Stage 1 = economy rebalance patch, night skip to 7:00, morning bus home 8:00-9:30, hats-in-hair fix (plan-brief-pfu-1).
1. Open claude.ai/code. Pick repo cute-games/cozy-town, branch main.
2. Model: Opus 5.5, effort medium.
3. Type this one line:
Build stage 1 of the Pets and Farm Update. Brief: Cozy Town Main Book https://claude.ai/artifact/6VamW3iTDycZZjZnfTrZa3, entries, doc plan-brief-pfu-1. Patch: same book, collection kits, doc economy-rebalance. Read HANDOFF.md and CLAUDE.md first.
4. Claude makes a backup branch backup-YYYY-MM-DD, applies the patch, builds the rest, runs the quick kit after each change and the full check, then opens a pull request. Kit line N8: it adds the missing fixture, never weakens the line.
5. You: read the pull request, play it on iPad and PC, merge.
6. Say 'live 1' in the Plan chat: Plan writes the Live log.
Before stage 2: say 'pre-mortem stage 2' in Plan (pet brain is the biggest new system).
If the Claude Code chat can't read the book: say so in Plan; Plan makes a build page it can read.
Open picks, not blocking stage 1: Pet Shop fixes (stage 4), Pet Show podium (stage 5), jump field instructor (stage 6).
short: Start stage 1: open Claude Code, type one line
